reason: I already pay creators by UPI and judge them on views, which tells me nothing about who walked into the store, so a promo code with a customer count is actually useful. While it's free in the pilot I'd try one matched creator alongside my usual ones and compare.
objection: I can find creators on Instagram myself, and plenty will do barter for clothes, so once the pilot ends why pay cash plus a 10% fee on top? And my staff have to remember to tap +1 at the counter, which on a busy Saturday won't happen.
